# Archived GitHub Actions workflows

These YAML files are retained for historical reference but are deliberately stored outside `.github/workflows/`, so GitHub Actions will not register or run them. Their useful coverage has been consolidated into the sequential pipeline or superseded by the current v4 release process. Restore a file to `.github/workflows/` only after reviewing its version assumptions and re-integrating its checks.

Archived: old v2 general CI/security flows, v2-specific baseline/profile/release flows, the v3 incremental workflow, and the one-off v4 Issue 23 phase-0 workflow. The v2 correctness/vector suite was retained and renamed because its tests are still useful in the current pipeline. The hybrid benchmark was retained as an optional sequential phase.
